'''Syned One''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="TORSyned" /> located in the [[Syned system/Legends|Syned system]] of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]],<ref name="KEG">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> which was also in the Syned [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

Syned One featured on its surface an [[Syned One obelisk|alien obelisk]]. Every six [[Standard century/Legends|hundred years]], the alignment of the [[Star/Legends|stars]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] would make the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] obelisk reveal unusual inscriptions.<ref name="TORSyned" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Syned Conjunction" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the obelisk once again revealed the writings.<ref name="TORSyned" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to Syned One to observe the appearance of the inscriptions on the obelisk. The companion eventually deciphered a [[Map/Legends|map]] from the writings that led them to a strange discovery.<ref name="TORSyned" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Syned One was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill Mission "The Syned Conjuction," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TORSyned" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Syned system, and therefore Syned One, in grid square N-17.<ref name="TEA" />
